title: Developments In India And In The World South Asia Satellite
definition: The South Asia Satellite (officially designated as GSAT-9) is a geostationary communication and meteorology satellite launched by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) to provide various communication, broadcasting, and disaster management applications to South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) member nations.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Science and Technology (GS Paper III - Space Technology, India's Space Diplomacy, Soft Power, International Relations in South Asia, and Neighborhood First Policy).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational technical specifications and orbital dynamics of GSAT-9.
Evaluate geopolitical implications of India's space diplomacy and the 'Neighborhood First' policy.
Analyze regional benefits including tele-education, telemedicine, and disaster warning systems.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of ISRO launch vehicles
India's foreign policy framework in South Asia
